data.name: Musfirah
data.gender_notes: Musfirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Musfirah is an Arabic name that means pure and chaste, symbolizing innocence and moral integrity. It is a virtuous name that reflects the Islamic values of modesty and humility. The name Musfirah carries the meaning “Pure and Chaste” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Musfirah usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and chaste and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Musfirah is associated with the concept of taharah (purity) and is considered a blessing from Allah.
data.etymology: Musfirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure and Chaste.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Musfirah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: مسفرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: مسفرة هو اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل سفر الذي يعني النور والضياء، وهو اسم مقتبس من القرآن الكريم، يستخدم في الثقافة الإسلامية للفتيات التي تتميز بالنور والضياء في حياتها

in_urdu.name: مسفرہ
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب روشنی اور چمک
in_urdu.long_meaning: مسفرہ نام کا مطلب ہے روشنی اور چمک، یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اسلامی ثقافت میں لڑکیوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنی زندگی میں روشنی اور چمک کا سرچشمہ ہوتی ہیں

in_hindi.name: मुस्फ़िरह
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ प्रकाश और चमक
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुस्फ़िरह नाम का अर्थ है प्रकाश और चमक, यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लड़कियों के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है जो अपने जीवन में प्रकाश और चमक का स्रोत होती हैं

in_pashto.name: مسفره
in_pashto.meaning: نوم معنی چې رڼا او ځلا

data.cultural_impact: The name Musfirah holds high importance in Islamic culture due to its association with moral integrity and purity. It reflects the values of modesty and chastity that are highly revered in the Islamic community. The name is often used for young girls, instilling a sense of moral responsibility and ethical behavior from a young age.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Musfirah signifies the inner purification of the soul. It represents the ideal of striving towards a life of truthfulness, honesty, and righteousness. It is a reminder of the importance of maintaining one's spiritual and moral purity in the eyes of Allah. The name inspires individuals to lead a life of virtue and devotion, aligning themselves with the divine will and staying true to their faith.

historical_references.reference: Musfirah bint Abi Bakr al-Siddiq was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and is known for her generosity and hospitality. She was also one of the wives of Umar ibn al-Khattab.
historical_references.context: Musfirah was a prominent figure in early Islamic history and is remembered for her charitable acts and her role as a wife of a caliph.
